levels.title: Foundations
levels.summary: Combination, chlor-alkali, baking soda and the first carbon compounds.

achievements.name: Water Maker
achievements.hint: Hydrogen burns in oxygen to give water.
achievements.ncert: Ch. 1 · Chemical Reactions and Equations · Combination

achievements.name: Table Salt
achievements.hint: A reactive metal meets a poisonous gas: electrons are transferred and an ionic compound forms.
achievements.ncert: Ch. 3 · Metals and Non-metals · Ionic compounds

achievements.name: Chlor-alkali
achievements.hint: Pass electricity through brine, a solution of common salt in water.
achievements.ncert: Ch. 2 · Acids, Bases and Salts · Chlor-alkali process

achievements.name: Baking Soda
achievements.hint: Brine (salt and water), ammonia and carbon dioxide react together. Make ammonia from nitrogen and hydrogen.
achievements.ncert: Ch. 2 · Acids, Bases and Salts · Baking soda

achievements.name: Sunlight Swap
achievements.hint: Methane and chlorine swap atoms in sunlight: a substitution reaction.
achievements.ncert: Ch. 4 · Carbon and its Compounds · Substitution

achievements.name: Ethanoic Acid
achievements.hint: Oxidise ethanol. Ethanol comes from ethene and water; ethene from ethyne; ethyne from methane, which reacts on its own.
achievements.ncert: Ch. 4 · Carbon and its Compounds · Oxidation of alcohols

achievements.name: Fruity Ester
achievements.hint: Ethanoic acid and ethanol give a sweet-smelling ester. Both come from ethene.
achievements.ncert: Ch. 4 · Carbon and its Compounds · Esterification

levels.title: Acids and Light Metals
levels.summary: Burning ribbons, sulfur chemistry and neutralisation.

achievements.name: Ribbon of Fire
achievements.hint: A magnesium ribbon burns with a dazzling white flame in air.
achievements.ncert: Ch. 1 · Chemical Reactions and Equations · Combination

achievements.name: Brimstone
achievements.hint: Burn sulfur in oxygen. The oxide of a non-metal is acidic.
achievements.ncert: Ch. 3 · Metals and Non-metals · Non-metal oxides

achievements.name: Amphoteric Armour
achievements.hint: Aluminium coats itself in an oxide that reacts with both acids and bases.
achievements.ncert: Ch. 3 · Metals and Non-metals · Amphoteric oxides

achievements.name: Displacement
achievements.hint: A reactive metal pushes copper out of copper sulfate solution.
achievements.ncert: Ch. 1 · Chemical Reactions and Equations · Displacement

achievements.name: Antacid Action
achievements.hint: Milk of magnesia neutralises the hydrochloric acid in your stomach.
achievements.ncert: Ch. 2 · Acids, Bases and Salts · Antacids

achievements.name: King of Chemicals
achievements.hint: Take sulfur dioxide one oxidation step further, then add water.
achievements.ncert: Ch. 2 · Acids, Bases and Salts · Strong acids

achievements.name: Neutralisation
achievements.hint: An acid and a base give a salt and water.
achievements.ncert: Ch. 2 · Acids, Bases and Salts · Neutralisation

levels.title: Metals in Action
levels.summary: Rusting, metals with steam and acid, and the ores of zinc.

achievements.name: Rust Never Sleeps
achievements.description: Form iron(III) oxide (Fe₂O₃), better known as rust.
achievements.hint: Iron slowly combines with oxygen: corrosion.
achievements.ncert: Ch. 1 · Chemical Reactions and Equations · Corrosion

achievements.name: Zinc White
achievements.hint: Zinc oxide is amphoteric: it reacts with acids and with bases.
achievements.ncert: Ch. 3 · Metals and Non-metals · Amphoteric oxides

achievements.name: Blue-green Solution
achievements.hint: Copper reacts with chlorine directly, or hydrochloric acid reacts with a copper base.
achievements.ncert: Ch. 3 · Metals and Non-metals · Metals and non-metals

achievements.name: Iron and Steam
achievements.hint: Red-hot iron reacts with steam and releases hydrogen.
achievements.ncert: Ch. 3 · Metals and Non-metals · Metals and water

achievements.name: Zinc Blende
achievements.description: Form zinc sulfide (ZnS), the main ore of zinc.
achievements.hint: Hydrogen sulfide reacts with zinc hydroxide. Sulfide ores like this are roasted to extract the metal.
achievements.ncert: Ch. 3 · Metals and Non-metals · Ores and extraction

achievements.name: Hydrogen Hunter
achievements.hint: Zinc granules in dilute sulfuric acid bubble out hydrogen.
achievements.ncert: Ch. 2 · Acids, Bases and Salts · Acids with metals

achievements.name: Green Crystals
achievements.hint: Iron in dilute sulfuric acid. The crystals decompose when heated.
achievements.ncert: Ch. 1 · Chemical Reactions and Equations · Decomposition

levels.title: Rarer Elements
levels.summary: Oxides, acids with metals and the reactivity series with nickel, beryllium and boron.

achievements.name: Green Oxide
achievements.hint: Nickel burns in oxygen to give a basic oxide.
achievements.ncert: Ch. 3 · Metals and Non-metals · Metals and oxygen

achievements.name: Metalloid Oxide
achievements.hint: Boron is a metalloid; its oxide is acidic.
achievements.ncert: Ch. 3 · Metals and Non-metals · Metalloids

achievements.name: Green Chloride
achievements.hint: Metals react with chlorine to form ionic chlorides.
achievements.ncert: Ch. 3 · Metals and Non-metals · Metals and non-metals

achievements.name: Iodide Reagent
achievements.hint: Hydroiodic acid meets potassium hydroxide. You will need KI again at Level 5.
achievements.ncert: Ch. 2 · Acids, Bases and Salts · Neutralisation

achievements.name: Fizzing Carbonate
achievements.hint: A metal carbonate fizzes with sulfuric acid, giving a salt, carbon dioxide and water.
achievements.ncert: Ch. 2 · Acids, Bases and Salts · Metal carbonates + acids

achievements.name: Metal in Acid
achievements.hint: A metal dissolves in dilute sulfuric acid and releases hydrogen.
achievements.ncert: Ch. 2 · Acids, Bases and Salts · Acids with metals

achievements.name: Reactivity Series
achievements.hint: Make nitric acid first: oxidise nitrogen step by step, then add water. It can then react with a nickel base, or nickel can displace copper from copper nitrate.
achievements.ncert: Ch. 3 · Metals and Non-metals · Reactivity series

levels.title: Master Chemist
levels.summary: Precipitates, light-sensitive silver salts and the ores of mercury.

achievements.name: Golden Rain
achievements.description: Form lead(II) iodide (PbI₂), the yellow precipitate.
achievements.hint: Lead nitrate solution meets potassium iodide solution: a double displacement.
achievements.ncert: Ch. 1 · Chemical Reactions and Equations · Double displacement

achievements.name: Light-sensitive
achievements.hint: Silver reacts with chlorine. The product turns grey in sunlight (photolysis).
achievements.ncert: Ch. 1 · Chemical Reactions and Equations · Photolytic decomposition

achievements.name: Roasting Cinnabar
achievements.hint: Heat mercury in oxygen. Roasting cinnabar gives the same oxide.
achievements.ncert: Ch. 3 · Metals and Non-metals · Ores and extraction

achievements.name: Tarnish
achievements.hint: Silver turns black in air that contains hydrogen sulfide: hydrogen sulfide meets silver hydroxide here.
achievements.ncert: Ch. 1 · Chemical Reactions and Equations · Corrosion

achievements.name: Cinnabar
achievements.description: Form mercury(II) sulfide (HgS), the red ore of mercury.
achievements.hint: Hydrogen sulfide reacts with mercury(II) hydroxide.
achievements.ncert: Ch. 3 · Metals and Non-metals · Ores and extraction

achievements.name: White Precipitate
achievements.hint: Sulfate ions meet barium ions and a white solid drops out of solution.
achievements.ncert: Ch. 1 · Chemical Reactions and Equations · Precipitation

achievements.name: Brown Fumes
achievements.hint: Neutralise nitric acid with lead hydroxide. On heating it gives brown fumes.
achievements.ncert: Ch. 1 · Chemical Reactions and Equations · Thermal decomposition
